notes.title: Season 4.5 Update - "Dark Essence"
notes.notes:
We're thrilled to introduce Season 4.5. This season brings the mysterious Dark Bosses, extends the Underrealm to unprecedented depths, introduces powerful Tier 5 equipment, and delivers a comprehensive rebalancing of the entire modification system. Prepare for darker challenges and greater rewards.


🕯️ Tuesday, August 12th at 1:00 PM EST –Chaos Days begin!

 The servers will go down briefly (up to 1 hour) as we prep for the new season.
 Seasonal characters will be wiped, so don’t forget to migrate the ones you want to keep into Offline Mode!

 🎁 Bonus: Everyone who participates in Chaos Days will receive the exclusive Ride of Swordie'm Mount! 


🧿 Friday, August 15th at 1:00 PM EST – Season 4.5: Dark Essence officially begins!

 The update will be live 1 hour before launch so you’ll have time to get ready.
 👉 RSVP to the launch event





New Content

Pants modifications now available - obtainable from monogram station or by defeating Olympus. 

Dark Boss Encounters
Six new endgame bosses await in the shadows, each offering exclusive rewards:  

Dark Olympus: Tier 5 Gloves and Chest pieces

Dark Drythus: Tier 5 Pants and Boots   

Dark Bridge: Tier 5 Helmets and Shields 

Dark Archeon: Tier 5 Bracers and Amulets 

Dark Zul: Tier 5 Rings

Dark Skorch: Tier 6 Weapons


Tier 5 Equipment System
Tier 5 armor pieces: Now have a chance to roll 3 random modifications 

T6 Weapons
T6 Weapons come with increased flat damage, three offhand modifiers (just like T5), plus one powerful unique effect from the list below:

Gain a 10% chance to get 1000 gold for killing an enemy.,

Gain Double Mastery Points.,

Gain 33% Chance to get Double Essence.,

Gain Double Experience points.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42825438/f97dc6e3b359f1b581cb443359b2280b277c1037.png"]
Extended Underrealm
Route expansion: Underrealm now extends to Rupture 500 (previously 300)  
 
New Monograms
Essence Empowerment: Gain 1 Damage for every 10 essence available 

Essence Precision: Gain 1 Critical Strike Chance for every 10 essence available  

Dark Essence: Hitting an Elite or Boss generates 0.1 Dark Essence per 100 of your highest stat. Dark Essence counts as normal Essence but cannot be used. Stacks up to 500

Phasing Resonance: While Phasing, grants 1 stack of Phasing every 2 seconds
  
Balance ChangesMonogram Rebalancing
'Lifesteal is now Energy steal. (Previously: Lifesteal is now Energy steal and you do not regenerate Health.) 

'Elite containers essence cost is reduced by 25%. (Previously: 10%)

'While moving, you generate Light Shroud stacks. Damaging an enemy replaces all stacks of Light Shroud with Dark Shroud. Gain 5% damage and 1% Base damage bonus for each Dark Shroud stack, lasts 30s. (Previously: 9s duration)

You cannot use uncharged Secondary Ability. Charged Secondary Ability deals 300% more damage. (Previously: 100% more damage)

Gain 5% Critical Damage for each extra inventory slot. (Previously: 2.5%)

Gain 1% Boss Damage for each extra inventory slot. (Previously: Gain 1% Attack Speed for each extra inventory slot.)

Gain 1% Critical Damage for every 5 essence collected. (Previously: every 10 essence)

Gain 20 to maximum Energy. (Previously: 12)

While Phasing - Gain 30% movement speed and trigger your offhands every 7.5 seconds. (Previously: every 10 seconds)

Gain 1% Crit Chance per potion slot. (Previously: Gain 2.5% Attack Speed per potion slot.)

When losing more than 40 stacks of Veil - gain 50% Movement Speed, 25% Health Regeneration and 50% Critical Damage bonus for 40 seconds. (Previously: gain movement speed, health regeneration and critical damage bonus.)

When losing more than 40 stacks of Light Shroud - gain 50% Movement Speed and 50 Base Damage for 15 seconds. (Previously: gain 50% movement speed and double Attack Speed for 7 seconds.)

Energy consumption is reduced by 50%. (Previously: 20%)

Your basic abilities cost 100 energy, but you gain a 200% damage bonus. (Previously: 100% damage bonus)

When completing dailies, other active fellowship members will gain 20% of their current level XP. (Previously: 1%)

Each time you get hit, Gain 15% more damage up to 75%. Blessing is 30 seconds long. (Previously: 5 seconds) 

Maximum Energy increased by 150%. (Previously: Gain 25 maximum Energy.)

Gain 0.5 Base Damage for each available potion. (Previously: Gain 100 attack speed for each available potion.)

Gain 2 Armor per Bloodlust stack. (Previously: 2% Armor) 

While in Berserker Fury, gain 2% damage reduction each time you're hit. Upon reaching maximum damage reduction, gain +100 base damage. (Previously: While in Berserker Fury state, gain 2% damage reduction every time you're hit.) 

Dark Shroud now also provides +2% Arcane Damage per stack. (Previously: +0.3%)

Dark Shroud now also provides +2% Fire Damage per stack. (Previously: +0.3%) 

Dark Shroud now also provides +2% Lightning Damage per stack. (Previously: +0.3%) 

Gain 300 damage, and any damage you take will deal at least 50% of your health. (Previously: 75% of your health)

Killing an elite grants you a Blessing that gives 2% Armor. Lasts 20 seconds, and stacks up to 100. (Previously: stacks up to 20) 

Killing an elite grants you a Blessing that gives 5% Damage Bonus. Lasts 20 seconds, and stacks up to 20. (Previously: gives 5% Attack Speed) 

Killing an elite grants you a Blessing that gives 1 maximum Energy. Lasts 20 seconds, and stacks up to 100. (Previously: stacks up to 20) 

Killing an elite grants you a Blessing that gives 2% maximum Health. Lasts 20 seconds, and stacks up to 50. (Previously: stacks up to 20)

Your Secondary Ability costs double energy, but deals 150% more damage. (Previously: 50% more damage) 

Killing an elite enemy reduces Berserker Fury's cooldown by 2 seconds. (Previously: 0.5 seconds)

Gain 5% maximum Health per Dark Shroud stacks. (Previously: per Light Shroud stack) 

Gain 1 additional potion slot for every 50 of your highest stat. (Previously: every 65)

After completing all dailies, gain 300,000 gold. (Previously: 250,000 gold) 

Every 4 seconds your character pulses with Arcane Damage. Each enemy hit grants a 3% Arcane Damage blessing, stacking up to 100. (Previously: 1%)

While in Berserker Fury state, gain +70% Damage Bonus. (Previously: gain double Attack Speed)

Gain 500 Luck if no offhands are equipped. (Previously: 250)

Gain 500 Dexterity if no offhands are equipped. (Previously: 250) 

Gain 500 Wisdom if no offhands are equipped. (Previously: 250) 

Gain 10% damage reduction. (Previously: 2%) 

Gain 200 Endurance. (Previously: 50)

Gain 200 Wisdom. (Previously: 50) 

Gain 200 Agility. (Previously: 50) 

Gain 200 Stamina. (Previously: 50) 

Gain 200 Strength. (Previously: 50) 

Gain 200 Luck. (Previously: 50) 

Gain 200 Dexterity. (Previously: 50)

Killing a monster or hitting an elite/boss has a 10% to trigger a bloodlust effect, gain 5% crit damage, 2% armor and 0.35% movement speed per stack. Stacks up to 100, lasts 15 seconds. (Previously: 0.4% attack speed instead of 2% armor)

Landing a critical strike has a chance to provide a stack of Excitement, providing 3% all Elemental Damage. At 20 stacks, become the Juggernaut - gaining +25% size, +40% movement speed, +25% critical chance and double your critical damage bonus. (Previously: providing 3% attack speed)

Gain 1% maximum Health for every 50 of your highest stat. (Previously: every 20 of your highest stat)

Gain 1% Damage for every 5 essence available. (Previously: Gain 5% Damage for every 80 essence available)

When killing an elite enemy, gain 10% chance to spawn another elite. (This modification stacks up to 8 times) 

Gain 15% movement speed.  -Removed  
Offhands
Lightning Plasma now grows 20% longer in range and attacks faster by 13.33%. (Previously: Lightning Plasma now grows 20% longer in range) (This modification can stack up to 3 times)


Arcane Apocalypse gains a 50% chance to explode a second time. (Previously: 20% chance) 


Spinning Blade spawns another blade on the battlefield dealing 50% damage. (Previously: 100% damage)

Spinning Blade: Shoots a shuriken from each blade, dealing 25% damage. For each shuriken, the spinning blades get 5% additional damage. (Previously: 50% damage and 10% additional damage)
 

Eye of the Storm base damage increased by 10%

Eye of the Storm will stay for an additional 1.5 seconds and deals additional 33% damage per radius modification. (Previously: Eye of the Storm will stay for an additional 1.5 seconds) 
 

When Vortexes collide, they turn into a thunderstorm that deals 300% additional damage over 1.5 seconds. Multiple thunderclouds can now exist simultaneously. (Previously: limited to 1 thundercloud)


Delusion of Zelkors: Spawn three additional mages. (Previously: two additional mages)

Delusion of Zelkors: Mages' explosions now spawn fire spikes, dealing an additional 20% damage for every active mage. (Previously: 15% damage)


Blood Dragons: Dragons gain a 15% chance to trigger a Dragon Burst that deals 200% damage and an additional 33% damage based on dragon size. (Previously: Dragons gain a 15% chance to trigger a Dragon Burst that deals 200% damage)


Fiery Totems: Fiery Totems triggered by you gain an additional 40% damage for each Fiery Totem on the battlefield. (Previously: 10% damage)

Fiery Totems: Walking over a Fiery Totem causes it to explode, setting off all other Fiery Totems. Totems that explode without dealing damage spawn an Ember Ghost that tracks enemies and deals 120% damage. (Previously: 100% damage)

Fiery Totems: Fiery Totems you activate become infused with a Fire Vortex that deals 55% damage three times per second. (Previously: 10% damage)

Fiery Totems: Creates a Wall of Fire in front of the player that deals 33% damage three times per second. (Previously: 110% damage) 


Kraken Seed: Kraken Seed shoots 4 tentacle darts, dealing 60% damage each. (Previously: 40% damage)

Kraken Seed: Running over a Kraken Seed will shoot projectiles that explode on impact, dealing 


Burning Shield: Surrounds your shields with Fire Swords, increasing the damage by 50% and radius by 33%. (Previously: damage by 33%)

Burning Shield: Burning shield becomes a legendary fire shield, increasing its size by 10% and damage by 20% and grants a Blessing that gives 1% Fire Damage and 1% Armor, stacks up to 75. (Previously: stacks up to 25)

Burning Shield: The Shield will stay an additional 2 seconds. When the shield dissipates, it triggers a Fire explosion dealing 500% base damage + 25% more damage based on the shield radius. (Previously: 10% more damage based on shield radius)


Death Blade: When Death Blade despawns, it will summon an arcane spike on a nearby enemy, dealing 80% damage + 20% additional damage for every second the blade was on the field. (Previously: 10% per second)

Death Blade: Summon a smaller Death Blade that circles around the primary Death Blade and deals 130% damage. Each time a small death blade spawns, it adds 15% damage to Arcane spike. (Previously: 5% damage per blade)


Static Charge: Static Charge increases its damaging radius by 20%. Thunderbolts have a 20% chance to deal an additional 25% damage based on Static Charge time.' (Previously: Static Charge increases its damaging radius by 20%) (Note: Chance scales with mod stacks; damage scales with additional time stacks)


Dragon Flame: The dragon breathes more flames dealing 75% increased damage. (Previously: 50% increased damage)

Dragon Flame: Increase radius of fire breath area by 40% and have 15% chance to deal double damage. (Previously: Increase radius of fire breath area by 40%)


Lightning Totems: Totems range grows by 40%. Totems deal an additional 20% damage for every totem in its range. (Previously: 10% additional damage)

Lightning Totems: Totems stay for an additional 0.6 seconds and have a 25% chance to pulse with electricity when struck by lightning, dealing 150% damage. (Previously: stay for additional 0.2 seconds)


Toxicity: On spawn 25% chance to fire a toxic projectile that will spawn another toxicity pool. (Previously: 15% chance with no stack limit) (This modification stacks up to 3 times to prevent infinite procs and performance issues)


Starblades: Gain an additional blade that deals 50% damage. (Previously: 75% damage) 

Starblades: For each extra blade, all blades deal 50% additional damage. (Previously: 70% additional damage) 


Ferocity of Wolves: Your wolves increase their damage by 20% with each leap. (Previously: 35% damage) 


Spark: When Sparks collide, they have a 33% chance to spawn a plasma sphere that deals 75% damage. After 2 seconds it explodes for 200% damage. Plasma sphere may consume sparks to gain +50% damage bonus. (Previously: 15% chance to spawn plasma sphere dealing 50% damage, explodes after 4 seconds, +30% damage bonus from consuming sparks)


Fire Beam: After a few seconds, the beam expands, lasting an additional second and dealing 55% more damage. (Previously: 40% more damage) 


Electric Dragons: Gain an additional Electric Dragon, increasing its damage radius by 60%. (Previously: 50% radius)

Electric Dragons: Each dragon has a 25% chance to shoot a burst of electric meteors that deal 75% damage. (Previously: 100% damage) 


Carnage of Fire: Increases explosion radius by 33%, spike damage by 25% and Scorching Fire duration by 1.5 seconds. (Previously: radius by 20%, spike damage by 10%, duration by 1 second)


Arcane Totems: Your totems fire two additional arcane flames. (Previously: one additional arcane flame) 

Arcane Totems: Totems have a 25% chance to explode when despawned, dealing 150% damage. (Previously: 15% chance)


Chain Lightning: With each link, Chain Lightning does additional 40% damage. (Previously: 25% additional damage)

---


Developer Notes
Season 4.5 focusing on three core pillars: endgame content expansion, player power enhancement, and build diversity. The introduction of Dark Bosses provides new challenges for our most dedicated players, while Tier 5 equipment opens entirely new optimization strategies.  The massive monogram rebalancing reflects our commitment to making every build path viable and exciting. We've dramatically increased player power across the board while introducing new scaling mechanics around essence management and secondary abilities.   The Underrealm expansion to rupture 500 provides significantly more progression content, while the offhand system overhaul ensures that these crucial build components feel impactful and rewarding to optimize.

notes.notes:
Season 3.5 - AWAKENING Patch Notes
 Monday, March 31st Patch Notes:
Bug Fixes:

 Fixed various visual issues with a bunch of different Mounts.
 Slightly optimized Rain of Flames performance
 Resolved an issue that was causing Earthquake to stay on the battlefield after defeating Archeon.
 Elysia can no longer be pushed off the map.
 Removed spear related item from Archery Underrealm rewards.
 Prime Trux the Imp will now properly display the warning indication of all 3 lasers.
 Fixed _"Gain 0.02% damage reduction for every 100..."_ to work with Highest stat.
 Added description about Experience Stones to Shadow stones.
 Fixed an issue where Sword's bracers would give double crit damage.
 Resolved an issue in Mardoth Bridge that was preventing enemies from spawning.


Gameplay:

 Gravedigger key recipe will now unlock before Elysia key recipe.
 Slightly reduced damage dealt by Shadowreaper boss and Prime Tombshade tornado attack.
 Health regeneration bonus from Quartz reward card increased to 10%.

__________________________________________________

 Tuesday, March 25th Patch Notes:
Bug Fixes:

 Optimized Mistress of Archeon VFX performance
 Improved collision in Min Lodhur, which should prevent players from getting stuck outside Boss Arena.
 Added controller support for Inventory Filter
 Fixed a calculation in Arcane apocalypse's Blackhole modifier. It should now deal the correct amount of damage.
 Resolved a navigation issue in The Hour Glass encounter that was preventing Apexious' minions from attacking the player.
 Removed an exploitable point in Mardoth Bridge that was causing enemies to become stuck.
 Fixed an issue with Archeon reward chest that was causing some items to be invisible.
 Reduced Prime Cavernous Ravager's rock attack damage.

__________________________________________________

 Monday, March 24th Patch Notes:

Bug Fixes:

 A major change has been made to the Character Save&Backup system which should prevent players from losing their character when abruptly disconnecting or closing the game.
 Resolved an issue that was causing Arcane Apocalypse to leave shadows behind even after the skill ended.
 Optimized performance of gaining Blood stacks.
 Fixed an issue where the player could go back to the arena after killing the boss in infused Dhim Tharim.
 Removed several exploitable spots in Ethereal Garden Temple rupture.  


__________________________________________________

 Sunday, March 23rd Patch Notes:
Bug Fixes:

 Resolved an issue that was causing Boss encounters to be instantly defeated upon spawning.
 Fixed a bug that was causing elite enemies to spawn on elevated grounds.
 Removed an invisible, blocking wall in The Hour Glass encounter.
 Fixed the issue causing rewards and enemies to spawn out of bounds in Mardoth Bridge
 "Increased mount speed by 80%" now working correctly
 Resolved the issue that was causing players to get stuck in the air during Skorch encounter.
 Fixed the issue making some Fists weapons to be held weird. 
 Fixed the issue causing some skins to become twisted when using fists weapons.  
 Made slight performance optimizations to Arcane Apocalypse and Fiery Totems.


*For changes made during the pre-season Chaos Week, visit the Chaos Week Patch Notes Thread.

notes.notes:
[previewyoutube=TaO-zagMA8o;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey Adventurers! We've got an exciting update packed with new features, balance changes, and bugfixes.
Check out what's new in Season 3.5 of Dwarven Realms - Awakening:

NEW FEATURES IN SEASON 3.5 - AWAKENING 
INTRODUCING JUGGERNAUTS: THE FISTS STANCE 
Unleash your inner brawler with our brand-new FISTS class!
This powerful new combat style lets you pummel enemies with devastating close-range attacks.
Wield new specialized Fist Weapons with unique aesthetics.
Master an exciting combo system that rewards skillful play. Chain attacks to build combo points, then unleash devastating finishers. 
NEW RACE - ORC:

 Customize your character with race-specific clothing and appearance options
 Unlock racial traits that boost certain combat styles as you progress. (Applies to Humans as well)
 Crush Everything with a new playable race - The Orcs! and harness their natural strength and resilience in battle.

PRIME ELITE ENCOUNTERS
Face the ultimate challenge with our new Prime Elite mechanics: Elite enemies have a chance to spawn as a significantly more powerful 'Prime' variant of themselves.

 Encounter unique and enhanced attack patterns from Prime Elites
 Prime Elites have a lot more health and deal more damage  
 Prime Elites feature spectacular visual effects to distinguish them

GAMEPLAY

 Improved Cave Crasher's Rock Trail effects.
 Added tooltips to Essence Turn-in.
 Renamed Charging affinity to Momentum.
 Introduced a new affinity: Hazard - to allow for better distribution of affinities across offhands.
 Health Regeneration% stat now increases the player's base health regeneration - instead of adding a % of health as flat regeneration.
 Default Rupture Containers no longer drop equipment.
 Experience gained through Research Table (Scrolls, Tablets, and Books) has been reduced.
 Experience bonus gained from upgrading the Research Table significantly increased.
 Flat Damage can now only appear as a base affix for Weapons.
 Reduced the number of items that drop in Ruptures.
 Increased Qhik'zichar mount drop rate.

META / BALANCE CHANGES

 We've updated the formulas for enemy health scaling and player damage calculation to improve balance and progression.
Enemy health now scales more dynamically based on difficulty, while player damage calculations have been refined to ensure smoother power growth across levels.

 As part of the effort to get more diverse playstyles, we've disconnected the hard link between specific stats and stances. Basically allowing players to combine any stance with any stat distribution.
 
  Removed the stat scaling bonuses from Stance Proficiency
  Legendary (purple) items can now roll with any of the 7 stat attributes.      
   
 As with every season, we've made updates to Offhand Abilities and Monograms. Also Stance Attacks have undergone a refinement of Damage and Energy costs. You can review the full details below


BUGFIXES

 Potions will now only be collected if the player an empty potion slot
 Celestial forge can no longer be closed unexpectedly
 Improved visuals for epic antler weapon containers
 Fixed an issue where lightning beam was not attached to the player


USER INTERFACE

 Limited loot popup on lower right of screen to 10 rows maximum
 "Unlearn" option in skill tree only appears after using at least one skill point
 Added Infused rupture selector overlay
 Added search box to mounts, pets and skins lists

notes.title: Season 3 Chaos Week - Fixes Patch
notes.notes:
Season 3 Chaos Week - Fixes Patch
26th of January - Meta Breaking Changes ahead:
We hope you're having fun playing Season 3 Chaos week! 
Thanks to your commitment, we've already identified several large - game breaking - issues.
The Fix patch is now live, patch notes in list below.
As expected from Chaos week, this means we will likely have another reset coming within the next few days.
The good news is, everyone participating in Chaos week will also receive an additional cosmetics reward! 
 Patch notes:
Empowered Attacks

 Removed a miscalculation in the new Empowered Attacks system that was causing all players in all scenarios to deal double damage. - Ya'll didn't notice the game was easy as pie? 
 Resolved an issue where Empowered Cyclone Frenzy was not dealing damage behind the player.
 Fixed a bug that was causing Empowered Blood Swirl to not receive the correct radius increase bonus.
 Resolved an issue that was causing some Empowered attacks to deal damage to players. 

Skill Tree

 Fixed various typo's in skill tree node descriptions.
 Fixed the issue where players were not consuming gold when unlearning nodes in skill tree.
 Fixed 'Taste My Lightning' node to give correct lightning bonus damage.
 Fixed an issue where players would gain _Charged Defense Blessing_ without spending skill points.
 Fixed an issue where players would keep _Infuriated Health  Blessing_ after unlearning the node.
 Fixed Blood Boil nodes to give the correct amount of critical damage bonus.
 Fixed the issue that was causing Blood Rage nodes to give Critical Chance instead of Critical Damage.
 Fixed description of Stance bonuses in selection nodes.
 Added Luck as an option to stat selection nodes.

Monogram

 Fixed the issue where Gain additional Potion Slot for per highest stat Monogram was not working properly.
 Fixed the issue where Gain 2 additional Potion Slots Monogram was not working.
 Fixed the Phasing trance effects increase by 10% Monogram to work as intended.
 Fixed the issue where Gain 0.05% Health per highest stat Monogram was not working as intended.
 Fixed the issue where Gain 1% Armor per Bloodlust stack Monogram was not working as intended.
 Fixed the Monogram granting Max Health for Elemental Damage to correctly calculate bonus health.

Fire Orbs Balance
We've Identified and resolved several issues with the way Fire Orbs calculates damage, especially with it's Ability Modifiers: 

 Fire Orbs: Cooldown increased by 0.2s
 Fire Orbs: Reduced Increasing intensity multiplier from 5% to 3%
 Modifier - Mini Orbs: Damage multiplier reduced to 20% of total Fire Orbs damage
 Modifier - Explode: Reduced explosion damage to be 65% of total Fire Orbs damage.
 Modifier - Explode: Fixed an issue where bonus damage for extra ticks was not scaling correctly. 

Stance related

 Fixed issue where Hurricane Havoc was not triggering Offhands correctly.
 Removed Mastery Scaling for early game Spears stance proficiency .
 Corrected the description of Bloodlust in Spears stance proficiency.
 Fixed an issue that was causing Sky Swords to collide with objects and not hit the ground.
 Resolved the problem with Empowered Magical Slash not hitting some enemies.

Misc.

 Fixed the issue that was causing enemies to spawn underground in new Harmonian maps.
 Added missing Ghauxst to new Infused Harmonian maps.
 Fixed an issue where enemies would stop attacking player in Massadin maps.
 Fixed an issue that was causing tooltips to display +0% bonuses.
 Added a scroll bar to the rewards shown in the Essence Turn-in station at the end of Ruptures.
 Resolved a sound issue that was causing Sword attacks to play wrong sounds.
 Tweaked opacity of Chaos Mine animation to reduce visual clutter.
 Resolved an issue that was preventing offline characters from Re:Specing.
 Cleared up incorrect text on Axe proficiency nodes.
 Updated Luck & Attack Speed Quartz card reward to give 15 Luck, in alignment with all other stats.
 Resolved an issue that was causing Dexterity to unintentionally increase player movement speed.
 Fixed sound effect blending for Phantasm Archers.
 Fixed the scenario where picking up fossil gems with a full inventory would cause players to lose gems.

notes.notes:
Gameplay and System Changes
 
 We're continuing to rework Ruptures and introducing new concepts for Myrh across all difficulty levels, from Rupture 1 to 5 and in the end-game.

  The "Bridge to the Demigod" dungeon key requirements have been adjusted to 3 Imbued Dwarven Runes (previously 5) and 10 of each scroll type (previously 5).

  New offhand ability modifiers are now available. All end-game weapons (level 15+) have a chance to drop with an additional ability modifier.

  Offhand crafting table: Upgrading offhand levels now yields more significant bonuses, ranging from 2% to 5% per level.

  We are now introducing two new ladder leagues: Regular, Regular Fellowship, Hardcore, and Hardcore Fellowship. The hardcore modifier has been removed and will be added later for all players as part of the elven tree.

  Defeating Zul now spawns three weapon racks instead of one.

  A new player tutorial concept is being introduced. Feedback from experienced players is encouraged, especially from those who can provide insights from a new user's perspective.

  Several offhand skills have received enhanced visual effects to improve game aesthetics.



Monogram and Balance Updates

  Life steal has been changed to energy steal and no longer disables health regeneration.

  The chance of spawning a container from elite kills has increased from 5% to 10%.

  For every 100 essence collected, players now receive a 5% damage bonus (increased from 1%).

  Players now gain 10 base damage for energy points above 100 (increased from 3).

  Killing an elite mob now has a 10% chance to spawn an Amadora Snail.

  The previous 1% Critical Chance bonus for every 10 essence collected now applies to Critical Damage instead.

  The 1% critical chance bonus per 10 luck is now distributed across all stats.

  Old monograms related to offhand skills are no longer available. Monograms for all offhand skills can now be obtained on weapons.

  The Dragonling elemental buff now stacks up to 25% with 5% per stack.

  The roll for offhand-specific modifiers has been reduced, while upgrades to offhand items have been made significantly more impactful.

Adjustments are being made to the difficulties of ruptures and bosses.


[previewyoutube=ua1iYSq82Wk;full][/previewyoutube]

 
We encourage exploration and testing of these recent changes. We are committed to continuous improvement and game balance, so expect more updates in the future. We greatly appreciate your continued support and feedback as we strive to enhance the gaming experience.

notes.title: Minor Patch 17.3
notes.notes:
Gameplay Balancing:

Damage Reduction Cards:

 Slightly nerfed the effectiveness of damage reduction cards for a more balanced gameplay experience.


NPC Accessibility in Home Fort:

 NPCs will not be unavailable at level 1, encouraging players to progress further before accessing certain features.


Rupture and Spawn Adjustments:

Initial 5 Ruptures:

 Conducted more tests and made changes to enhance the initial five rupture experiences.


Early Game Spawns:

 Slowed down spawns early in the game to provide players with a more manageable starting challenge.


Infused Raptures Spawn Areas:

 Implemented additional balance and tweaks to the spawn areas of Infused Raptures for improved player engagement.


Bug Fixes and Quality of Life:
Stance UI Buttons:

 Fixed a bug where stance UI buttons were not displaying correctly, ensuring a smoother user interface experience.

Sound Effects Settings:

 Adjusted various sound effects to properly reflect player settings, enhancing overall audio customization.


HUD Tweaks for Better User Experience (UX):

 Made minor tweaks to the HUD for a more user-friendly experience.


Thank you for your continued support and feedback! We hope these changes contribute to a more enjoyable and balanced gameplay environment. If you encounter any issues or have suggestions, feel free to let us know. Enjoy your adventures in the realm!

notes.title: Hotfix 17.2
notes.notes:
Gameplay Fixes and Tweaks:

Cathedral of Fire:

 More tweaks and fixes applied to enhance overall gameplay experience.


Ruptures:

 Infused Myrh Rupture: Fixed issues and implemented necessary adjustments.
 Kabarian Rupture: Addressed and fixed reported problems.
 First 5 Ruptures: Various fixes and improvements have been implemented.


Items and Descriptions:

 Added more item types and addressed description inconsistencies.


Unreal Engine Update:
[olist]
 The game engine has been upgraded to Unreal Engine version 5.3.2 for improved performance and stability.
[/olist]

User Interface (UI) Enhancements:

 Side roll functionality has been removed from the UI HUD. Players can now find it exclusively in the settings for those interested.


Ability and Spell Fixes:

 Arcane Orb Memory Leak: Resolved the memory leak issue associated with the Arcane Orb ability.
 Aiming Bug Fix: Fixed a bug where archery and magery aiming would sometimes be inaccurate.


Resource Balancing:

 Demigod Bridge Key: Adjusted the amount of resources required for crafting.


Dungeon Challenges:

 Dragon Chamber of Elysia: Tornado Walls: Slightly increased the damage inflicted by tornado walls.


Boss and Enemy Adjustments:

 Khaotica, Ambassador of Archeon: Increased the damage caused by arcane explosions.
 Mass, The Eternal Demigod Incarnation: Slightly increased the damage of the main ability.
 Bug Fixes:



 Tomb of the Ancients - Cellar: Resolved a bug where bright map slugs wouldn't drop maps.
 Dragonling Turn-in: Fixed a bug where turning in a dragonling might not consume it.
 Cathedral of Fire: Addressed an issue where tier 4 bracers for one hand and two hands were not dropping.


Training and Testing:

 Home Fort Base: Added a training dummy for players to gauge and compare the damage output of different builds.


Community Initiatives:
Wiki Project:
Started a community project to create a comprehensive wiki for the game. Check the progress and contribute at Dwarven Realms Wiki.

Thank you for your continued support, and we hope you enjoy the latest improvements and additions to the game! If you encounter any issues or have feedback, please don't hesitate to reach out to us.
